title: Turner's virtual reality scenarios in abductions

tellings.quote: She referred to what something she described as virtual reality scenarios,

plain: Karla Turner, a researcher who studied people's accounts of being abducted by aliens, described what she called virtual reality scenarios: staged scenes that seemed real, put on during an abduction. The filmmaker Tim Alberino brings up her work on Michels's show. If true, it would mean that what abductees remember may be an illusion they were put through, not what really happened.
